message.content: This file implements functions for erasing and rewriting a program-page-aligned range of flash memory. The `flash_swap_append` function appends a new program page to the end of a swap image, erasing the old page and copying the new data. The `flash_swap_rewrite` function rewrites a range of data in a spare sector, erasing the old data and copying the new data. The functions use internal modules such as `flash_swap.h` and `flash.h` to access flash memory operations. The code is designed to work with a program-page-aligned image and a spare sector, and it handles errors by returning -1 when an error occurs. The code also includes some design decisions, such as erasing the old page before copying the new data, and using a spare sector to retain ordinary block-rewrite semantics without a full erase sector in SRAM.
